items.title: Child in New York dies after contracting measles, the state’s first such death in 30 years
items.brief: A child in Lewis County, New York, has died after contracting measles, officials announced Monday.

items.title: US military conducts strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island in defensive operation, officials say
items.brief: The US military carried out limited strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island on Monday, three US officials told CNN, characterizing the action as defensive in nature and meant to protect US assets in the region.

items.brief: Late last fall, Haley Stevens decided to get off social media.

items.title: Texas couples, 2 young children, caregiver and pilots killed in Florida Learjet crash
items.brief: In the blink of an eye, a private jet plummeting 450 feet per second nosedived into a Florida roadway, bursting into flames and killing all nine people on board .

items.title: Deadly flooding forces evacuations in Southwest as storm shifts east for Election Day
items.brief: A storm causing historic flooding, evacuations and rescues in the Southwest is now pushing into the central United States, where it will bring soggy weather on Election Day on Tuesday.

items.title: Greenland’s new airport is for tourists. But it could also support a future independent state
items.brief: Greenland has opened a new international airport, seeking to lure visitors from around the world as the Arctic island looks toward eventual independence from Denmark.
